args.text: Hi June, approval request: Dana Okafor (Quarrendon Freight Lines account owner) has asked me to save a draft mail in her mailbox to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) for the territory review, subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", giving the proposed 2027 per-seat rate of $2,356 from her call with the customer yesterday. Since Hollis isn't the account owner, CFO or deal desk, sharing the rate with him needs your (or Anselm's) approval. OK to prepare that draft?

Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, and those can go to you, Anselm and June. Hollis runs Central and isn't any of those, so sending him the rate needs Anselm's or June's sign-off first. I've messaged June asking her to approve it. Once she does, I'll save the draft to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" in your mailbox for you to send.

I haven't saved the draft yet. Your email to Hollis Mbeki needs approval first.

I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
